create_F2_regularizer: create an F2 regularizer instance with a specified weight for L2 norm regularization
create_N3_regularizer: create an N3 regularizer instance with a specified weight for L3 norm regularization
use_F2_forward: use the F2 forward method to compute L2 regularization loss over factor tensors
use_N3_forward: use the N3 forward method to compute L3 regularization loss over factor tensors
extend_Regularizer_base: extend the Regularizer abstract base class to implement a custom regularization strategy
